de.name: Rizal Shrine

de.text: Die Pfarrkirche Santo Niño de Tondo ist ein katholisches Heiligtum in Manila, das der Verehrung des Heiligen Kindes gewidmet ist.

de.text: Dieses Denkmal ehrt die als Katipunan bekannte revolutionäre Gesellschaft, die für die philippinische Unabhängigkeit kämpfte.

de.text: Die Pfarrei Nuestra Señora de la Soledad ist eine lokale religiöse Kultstätte, die Unserer Lieben Frau von der Einsamkeit gewidmet ist.

de.text: Der am 4. August 1997 in Betrieb genommene Leuchtturm des Pasig-Flusses leitet den Schiffsverkehr an der Flussmündung.

hu.text: A Plaza Moriones egy nyitott köztér, amely a Tondo negyed közösségi zöldterületeként ismert.

hu.text: A Kínai negyed múzeuma Binondo gazdag kulturális történelmét bemutató műtárgyakat és kiállításokat tár a látogatók elé.

hu.text: A Gerizim evangéliumi templom protestáns szellemi gyülekezőhelyet biztosít a helyi hívek számára.

hu.text: A Po Chuan Am templom a helyi kínai-fülöp-szigeteki közösséget szolgáló hagyományos imahely.

hu.text: Az 1997. augusztus 4-én alapított Pasig folyó világítótornya a tengeri forgalmat irányítja a folyó torkolatánál.

hu.text: A Baluarte de San Gabriel egy robusztus védelmi előőrs, amely a spanyol gyarmati mérnöki munkára jellemző vastag kőfalakkal rendelkezik.

ro.text: Acest monument onorează societatea revoluționară cunoscută sub numele de Katipunan, care a luptat pentru independența Filipinelor.

en.name: Rizal Shrine
en.text: Located within Intramuros, this memorial museum features the brick barracks where the national hero José Rizal was imprisoned.

en.name: Saint Peter's Church
en.text: Saint Peter's is a notable Episcopal church serving worshippers in the Manila area.

en.name: Santo Niño de Tondo Parish Church
en.text: The Santo Niño de Tondo Parish Church is a Catholic sanctuary known for its devotion to the Holy Child in Manila.

en.name: Binondo Church
en.text: Binondo Church is a major Catholic place of worship located in Manila's historic Chinatown.

en.name: Binondo-Intramuros Bridge
en.text: The Binondo-Intramuros Bridge is a modern river crossing inaugurated on April 5, 2022.

en.name: Fort Santiago
en.text: Fort Santiago is a historic defensive citadel that originally guarded the entrance to the Pasig River in Manila.

en.name: Plaza Moriones
en.text: Plaza Moriones is an open public square known as a gathering green space in the Tondo district.

en.name: Plaza Liga Filipina
en.text: Plaza Liga Filipina is a green space dedicated to the nationalist organization founded by José Rizal.

en.name: Chinatown Museum
en.text: The Chinatown Museum showcases artifacts and exhibits detailing the rich cultural history of Binondo.

en.name: Calvo Museum
en.text: The Calvo Museum features historical collections preserving Manila's urban heritage and memorabilia.

en.name: Kataastaasan Kagalanggalang na Katipunan ng mga Anak ng Bayan
en.text: This monument honors the revolutionary society known as the Katipunan, which fought for Philippine independence.

en.name: Nuestra Señora de la Soledad Parish
en.text: Nuestra Señora de la Soledad Parish is a local religious worship site dedicated to Our Lady of Solitude.

en.name: Gerizim Evangelical Church
en.text: Gerizim Evangelical Church provides a Protestant spiritual gathering place for local congregants.

en.name: Po Chuan Am Temple
en.text: Po Chuan Am Temple is a traditional place of worship serving the local Chinese-Filipino community.

en.name: Locale of Baseco
en.text: The Locale of Baseco is an active place of worship situated in the densely populated Baseco compound.

en.name: HS Commercial Tower
en.text: The chapel at HS Commercial Tower offers a quiet space for prayer within a modern business building.

en.name: Gate 7
en.text: Gate 7 is one of the historic stone entry points forming part of the city's ancient defensive fortifications.

en.name: Pasig River Esplanade
en.text: The Pasig River Esplanade is a scenic riverside walkway offering wide views over the urban waterway.

en.name: Puerta de Almacenes
en.text: Puerta de Almacenes is an old archway structure built to provide access to the former royal storehouses.

en.name: Pasig River Lighthouse
en.text: Established on August 4, 1997, the Pasig River Lighthouse guides maritime traffic at the mouth of the river.

en.name: Baluarte de San Gabriel
en.text: Baluarte de San Gabriel is a robust defensive outpost featuring thick stone walls typical of Spanish colonial engineering.
